title: Doomsday Escape
description: Sprint through crumbling apocalyptic streets—blast zombies blocking your path, rescue survivors, and reach the extraction chopper.
controls: Drag to steer your survivor squad, shoot approaching threats, and gather ammo boosts.

zh-CN.title: 末日大逃生
zh-CN.description: 紧张刺激末日求生大逃生：在危机四伏的废土街道一路突围，开火清怪营救幸存者冲向安全区！
zh-CN.controls: 拖动控制幸存者小队灵活走位并自动开火清怪，一路冲出末日险境。
